source.method: Onkelos-supported lexical anchors as starting point; every verse reviewed word by word (reviewed.json)

1:1.note: 'when the children of Israel went out' (ܒܢܝ ܐܝܣܪܝܠ plus); ܠܗ plus.

1:2.note: 'sum of the number of heads' for ראש.

1:16.note: Ketiv/qere קריאי/קרואי both linked; 'tribes of the house of their fathers'.

1:24.note: Plus 'every male by their heads' (as in v20/22) and ܒܐܝܣܪܝܠ.

1:50.note: ܐܠܐ and ܡܕܡ plus; 'appoint' as ܐܫܠܛ.

1:51.note: Temporal infinitives paraphrased with ܡܐ ܕ; ܠܗ plus.

2:9.note: Thousands grouped; periphrastic 'they shall be setting out first'.

2:17.note: ידו unrendered; 'with his troop by their hosts'.

2:33.note: Plus 'and the tribe of their fathers' (cf. 1:47).

2:34.note: Plus 'so he did'; clauses inverted (set out before encamped).

3:4.note: 'in the lifetime of Aaron' for על פני.

3:16.note: 'by the word of the mouth of the LORD'.

3:25.note: 'and the front of the door' replaces והאהל (uncertain, left unlinked).

3:37.note: Items reordered; ܓܠܓܐ for pegs uncertain.

3:40.note: 'spoke ... and said to him' for ויאמר.

4:5.note: 'face of the door that is spread' for פרכת המסך.

4:7.note: Vessel terms rendered by Syriac equivalents.

4:14.note: Vessel list rendered with Syriac terms.

4:15.note: Temporal clauses with ܡܐ ܕ; ܐܢܘܢ plus.

4:16.note: 'has authority over'; ܡܢ and ܡܕܡ plus.

4:20.note: 'while the sanctuary is covered'; ܕܠܐ 'lest' makes negative purpose.

5:3.note: Both 'send out' verbs in one ܬܦܩܘܢ; 'your camp' for מחניהם.

5:6.note: 'sons of man'; 'do iniquity before the LORD'.

5:7.note: 'one of five' for fifth; paraphrased restitution.

5:8.note: Paraphrase 'one who is near to him' for גאל; 'bring in exchange' for השיב/המושב; proleptic ܠܗ; ܢܗܘܐ plus.

5:15.note: Minus 'his wife ... and shall bring'; עליה unrendered.

5:17.note: 'skirts of the altar' for floor of the tabernacle.

5:18.note: 'waters of testing' for המאררים; היא unrendered.

5:21.note: Jussive paraphrase 'may the LORD rot your thigh'.

5:27.note: Minus opening 'he shall make her drink ... it shall be'.

5:28.note: ܕܝܢ plus; 'bear a male' for 'conceive seed'.

7:1.note: Object suffix plus ܠ-objects for את.

7:3.note: Syriac 'well-equipped' for צב; MT 'before the LORD' kept.

7:9.note: 'was entrusted to them' for עלהם; ܘ plus.

7:10.note: Syriac 'before the LORD' for MT 'before the altar' (unlinked).

7:12.note: 'head of the tribe of the house of Judah'.

7:13.note: Formulaic offering list; ܡܢ plus before weights.

7:18.note: Chief-of-tribe formula moved before the name.

7:19.note: הקריב את unrendered; ܡܢ plus before weights.

7:24.note: Chief-of-tribe formula moved before the name.

7:25.note: Formulaic offering list; ܡܢ plus before weights.

7:30.note: Chief-of-tribe formula moved before the name.

7:31.note: Formulaic offering list; ܡܢ plus before weights.

7:36.note: Chief-of-tribe formula moved before the name.

7:37.note: Formulaic offering list; ܡܢ plus before weights.

7:42.note: Chief-of-tribe formula moved before the name.

7:43.note: Formulaic offering list; ܡܢ plus before weights.

7:48.note: Chief-of-tribe formula moved before the name.

7:49.note: Formulaic offering list; ܡܢ plus before weights.

7:54.note: ܩܪܒ plus; 'head of the tribe of Manasseh'.

7:55.note: Formulaic offering list; ܡܢ plus before weights.

7:60.note: Chief-of-tribe formula moved before the name.

7:61.note: Formulaic offering list; ܡܢ plus before weights.

7:66.note: Chief-of-tribe formula moved before the name.

7:67.note: Formulaic offering list; ܡܢ plus before weights.

7:73.note: Formulaic offering list; ܡܢ plus before weights.

7:79.note: Formulaic offering list; ܡܢ plus before weights.

8:2.note: 'When you raise' rendered 'when you light'; 'they shall be shining' periphrasis.

8:4.note: 'From its base to its head' for 'to its shaft to its flowers'; 'casting' for hammered work.

8:8.note: Plus 'one' and 'one bowl full of' before fine flour.

8:16.note: Doubled 'given' rendered by noun plus participle.

8:17.note: 'From men to beasts' periphrasis; pronoun 'them' plus.

8:19.note: Proleptic pronoun plus; 'death' for plague; plus 'suddenly'.

8:22.note: Plus 'the children of Israel' at end.

8:24.note: Plus 'law' ('this shall be the law of the Levites').

9:1.note: Plus 'the children of Israel' as subject of exodus; 'to him' plus.

9:13.note: 'Did not do' for 'ceased to do'; plus 'in its time'.

9:15.note: Plus 'the front of the door'; 'tent of meeting' for tabernacle.

9:18.note: 'At the word of the mouth' for 'at the mouth'.

9:22.note: 'From time to time' for 'days'; 'upon it' (12) not rendered.

10:5.note: 'Sound an alarm' renders blow+alarm; plus 'with the horn'.

10:6.note: Plus 'with the horn' in first clause.

10:11.note: Day numeral differs ('tenth' vs MT twentieth) and is placed before month.

10:25.note: Plus 'of the tribe of the sons of Dan'.

10:28.note: Final 'and they set out' (6) not rendered.

10:30.note: 'To where I was born' for 'to my kindred'.

10:31.note: Plus explicit 'to him Moses'; 'na' (3) not rendered.

10:33.note: Ark goes 'one day's journey' for MT three days.

10:35.note: 'Enemies' and 'haters' swapped between the two verbs.

11:1.note: 'Murmured and it was evil before the LORD' for 'complaining evil in the ears of'.

11:8.note: Object pronouns 'it' added to each verb; 'kneaded with oil' for 'cream of oil'.

11:16.note: 'Heads and scribes' for elders and officers.

11:18.note: Narrative 'and Moses said to the people' for command 'say to the people'.

11:20.note: Plus 'you shall eat it'; 'before the LORD' for 'before him'.

11:22.note: 'What will they do for them' / 'where will they fill them' for 'will it suffice them'.

11:29.note: 'Do not be jealous for me'; 'who will make' for 'would that'.

12:6.note: Plus 'to them the LORD'; 'if your prophecy is of me, the LORD' paraphrase.

12:8.note: 'Glory of the LORD' for form; 'in likenesses' for riddles.

12:10.note: 'Saw that she was leprous' for 'behold, leprous'.

12:14.note: Conditional 'if her father had spat'; 'stay outside' for 'be shut'.

13:19.note: Most of MT verse (7-19: good or bad, cities, camps or fortresses) absent, likely homoioteleuton.

13:20.note: Opening 'and what is the land' and 'lean' (6) not rendered.

13:33.note: 'In their eyes' for 'in our eyes' in first clause.

14:3.note: 'Better for us while we dwelt in Egypt' for 'better to return to Egypt'.

14:4.note: 'Come, let us make us a head'.

14:9.note: 'Their strength' for 'their shade'; 'from them' plus at end.

14:18.note: Expanded with second-person forms and 'sons of sons'; 'generations' plus.

14:31.note: Large plus from Deut 1:39 ('your sons who knew not good and evil shall enter the land').

14:34.note: 'That you murmured before me' for 'my opposition'.

14:41.note: 'Therefore you shall not go up to the top' for 'it shall not prosper'.

14:45.note: 'Destroyed and pursued them' for 'smote and beat them'.

15:13.note: 'All of the house of Israel' for 'every native'.

15:14.note: Sojourner rendered 'one who turns to me' (proselyte).

15:25.note: Plus 'offering' before the LORD; 'folly' for error.

15:26.note: Proselyte paraphrase; 'in Israel' for 'in their midst'.

16:3.note: 'Is it not enough for you' for 'too much for you'.

16:9.note: 'Is it not enough for you' for 'is it too little'.

16:13.note: 'Is it not enough' for 'is it too little'; doubled 'lord it' paraphrased 'magnify yourselves'.

16:14.note: 'Our eyes' for 'the eyes of these men'.

16:24.note: 'Separate from around' for 'go up from around'.

16:26.note: 'Draw near' for touch; 'swallowed' for swept away.

16:30.note: Plus repeated 'they and all that they have'; doubled object ܐܢܘܢ ܠܗܘܢ = אתם.

17:2.note: 'Take the censers' for 'lift up the censers'.

17:7.note: 'Saw that the cloud covered it' for 'behold the cloud covered it'.

17:11.note: 'From upon the altar' (11-12) not rendered; plus 'in it', 'sudden' and 'among the people'; ܡܢ ܩܕܡ = מלפני.

17:14.note: Plus 'suddenly'; 'in the division of Korah' for 'concerning the matter of Korah'.

17:21.note: 'Said' for 'spoke'; 'for each chief of all of them' paraphrase.

17:23.note: 'On the next day'; 'brought forth leaves and bore almonds' condenses budding clauses.

18:7.note: 'Within the face of the door' for 'within the veil'.

18:9.note: 'Which they offer to me' for 'which they render to me'.

18:20.note: Plus 'the separated offerings of the LORD and his holy things'; 'I' (13) not rendered.

19:2.note: 'Bring to you a red cow'; 'on which a yoke has not fallen'.

19:5.note: Order skin, blood, flesh; 'with its dung'.

19:8.note: Plus 'the cow'; 'in water' (5) for garments not rendered.

19:9.note: 'Water of sprinkling' for water of impurity; plus 'kept'.

19:12.note: 'They shall sprinkle on him' for 'he shall purify himself'.

20:2.note: Plus 'people' and 'to drink'; congregation rendered as people.

20:3.note: Plus 'to him'; MT leʾmor not rendered.

20:5.note: Syriac adds negatives 'not even vines... nor water'; fig/vine order switched.

20:17.note: Plus 'but' and repeated negatives for right/left.

20:19.note: MT 'there is nothing (else)' not rendered; 1sg rendered 1pl.

20:24.note: Plus 'and did not sanctify me at the water before their eyes'.

20:28.note: 'On top of the mountain' rendered 'on Mount Hor'.

21:1.note: Arad rendered Geder; 'way of Atharim' rendered 'way of the spies'.

21:3.note: Plus 'into their hands' and 'laid them waste'.

21:8.note: Plus 'of brass' and 'whom the serpent bites'.

21:11.note: Iye-abarim rendered 'spring of the Hebrews'; doublet 'from the east'.

21:13.note: Free rendering of Arnon border clause.

21:14.note: Waheb in Suphah rendered 'flame in a storm'.

21:28.note: Ar rendered 'Ad'; 'lords of the high places' rendered 'servants of the altars'.

21:30.note: Dibon read Ribon; Medeba read as 'in the wilderness'; first verb rendered 'fields'.

22:3.note: Plus second 'very'; 'dreaded' rendered 'was weary of them'.

22:5.note: Pethor rendered 'interpreter'; 'his people' read as Ammon.

22:18.note: 'Mouth' rendered 'word of the mouth'; MT la'asot not rendered.

22:39.note: 'They came' rendered 'he brought him'; Kiriath-huzoth as Kiriath-hazeroth.

23:19.note: Rhetorical questions rendered as statements; plus 'for ever'.

24:1.note: 'Time after time' rendered 'as at every time'; 'to meet' rendered 'to know'.

24:2.note: 'According to his tribes' rendered 'tribes by tribes'.

24:3.note: 'Shut/open of eye' rendered 'whose eye is uncovered'.

24:7.note: First line differs: 'a man shall come forth from his sons' (cf. LXX).

24:13.note: 'Word of the mouth'; 'or' for ו between silver and gold; ܥܠ (ܥܒܪ ܥܠ) stands for את; enclitic ܐܢܐ linked to its verb.

24:17.note: 'Sceptre' rendered 'head'; 'corners of Moab' rendered 'mighty men of Moab'.

24:18.note: Restructured: Seir an inheritance of his enemies.

24:20.note: 'First of the nations' rendered 'head of the peoples'.

25:3.note: 'Joined himself' rendered 'was filled (devoted)'; Israel rendered 'sons of Israel'.

25:6.note: Plus 'and went in to'; uncertain construal of the Midianite clause.

25:8.note: ܒܪ ܐܝܣܪܐܝܠ = ישראל; 'in the cell' is a doublet of אל קבתה (read as קבה); plus 'sudden' (min shelya).

26:1.note: Plus 'sudden' after plague; MT le'mor not rendered.

26:3.note: 'Spoke to them' rendered 'spoke with them'; le'mor not rendered.

26:9.note: MT 'these are Dathan and Abiram' not repeated.

27:2.note: Plus 'before' repeated; MT le'mor rendered 'and they said'.

27:8.note: Imperative 'give' for 'cause to pass'; le'mor not rendered.

27:14.note: Plus 'and did not'; Kadesh rendered Rekem.

28:2.note: 'My food for my fire-offerings' paraphrased; plus 'be (keeping)'.

28:3.note: Tamim rendered 'without blemish'; 'olah' rendered 'whole burnt offering'.

28:14.note: Wine moved forward; 'be' repeated; ܝܩܕܐ ܫܠܡܐ = עלה; ܪܝܫ ܝܪܚܐ = חדש בחדשו.

28:26.note: 'New meal offering' rendered 'what you offer, fine flour from the new'.

28:31.note: MT 'shall be to you' not rendered.

29:7.note: MT 'you shall afflict your souls' not rendered.

29:8.note: MT 'shall be to you' not rendered.

29:16.note: Word-for-word; 'olat ha-tamid' rendered 'continual whole burnt offering'.

29:18.note: Mincha rendered 'fine flour'; 'as the ordinance' rendered 'according to their due'.

29:21.note: Mincha rendered 'fine flour'; 'as the ordinance' rendered 'according to their due'.

29:24.note: Mincha rendered 'fine flour'; 'as the ordinance' rendered 'according to their due'.

29:25.note: Word-for-word; 'olat ha-tamid' rendered 'continual whole burnt offering'.

29:27.note: Mincha rendered 'fine flour'; 'as the ordinance' rendered 'according to their due'.

29:30.note: Mincha rendered 'fine flour'; 'as the ordinance' rendered 'according to their due'.

29:33.note: Mincha rendered 'fine flour'; 'as the ordinance' rendered 'according to their due'.

29:36.note: Plus 'son of the herd'; lambs 'four' against MT 'seven'.

29:37.note: Mincha rendered 'fine flour'; 'as the ordinance' rendered 'according to their due'.

30:15.note: MT 'he has established them' not rendered.

31:28.note: Plus 'and from all the congregation'; 'five hundred' rendered 'fifty'.

32:1.note: Hebrew "land of Jazer" reduced to Jazer; "behold the place was a place of cattle" rendered "a place fit for cattle"; hinneh untranslated.

32:3.note: Names; Dibon read as Ribon (d/r), Shebam as Sheba.

32:4.note: "Congregation" rendered "sons" of Israel; "land of cattle" paraphrased "fit for cattle"; S adds "there is".

32:5.note: Mostly word-for-word; "in your eyes" rendered "before you".

32:6.note: Reuben/Gad order reversed; "come" rendered "go out"; extra pronoun.

32:7.note: Ketiv/qere tenu'un rendered "break"; S adds pronoun.

32:11.note: Oath particle im rendered "that not"; mostly word-for-word.

32:13.note: S adds "of men"; "in the eyes" rendered "before".

32:14.note: S adds "you too today"; Hebrew "al" before haron untranslated.

32:15.note: "From after him" rendered "from the Lord"; ki rendered "if".

32:17.note: Hushim "hastily" rendered "and go"; asher im merged into relative verb.

32:29.note: Reuben/Gad order reversed; word order shifted.

32:31.note: S adds "to Moses"; Reuben/Gad order reversed.

32:33.note: Bashan rendered Matnin; S adds "all"; Reuben/Gad order reversed.

32:38.note: Musabbot shem paraphrased "which took names"; S adds "upon".

32:42.note: Nobah read Nakah; Kenath read Qit.

33:1.note: Word-for-word; separate min for Hebrew prefix.

33:2.note: "Their goings forth" and "journeys" in reversed pairing; et omitted.

33:3.note: Duplicate date phrase compressed into one; S adds "from Egypt".

33:7.note: Vayashav rendered "encamped"; Pi-hahiroth translated "mouth of the trench".

33:8.note: "From before Hahiroth" rendered "from the mouth of the trench"; vaya'avru rendered "went".

33:9.note: S adds "there were" and "by the waters".

33:16.note: Kibroth-hattaavah translated "graves of the lusters of lust".

33:40.note: Arad read Geder (r/d confusion and metathesis).

33:45.note: Iyyim rendered "spring of the Hebrews"; Dibon read Ribon.

33:52.note: Masses of images: "molten" rendered as relative; bamot rendered "altars".

33:54.note: "There" and "to him it shall be" untranslated.

34:4.note: Akrabbim read Sepharvaim; Kadesh-barnea rendered Reqam de-Gaya; S adds auxiliaries.

34:9.note: Hazar-enan read Hezer Enan; S adds auxiliary.

34:11.note: Riblah read Diblat; "struck upon the shoulder" rendered "leaned on the side".

34:13.note: S adds "to them" and copula; titnahalu rendered "divide".

34:15.note: Qedmah rendered by qadmayit; S adds "there".

35:6.note: אשר תתנו replaced by 'shall be for you' (unlinked); plus 'who killed his neighbour unintentionally' (incl. ܕܩܛܠ).

35:15.note: Ger rendered "who turns to me"; S adds "to you".

35:18.note: O rendered "and if"; final ha-rotseah untranslated.

35:19.note: Go'el rendered "avenger"; final "he shall kill him" untranslated.

35:20.note: S adds "that one is a slayer".

35:25.note: Asher mashah oto rendered passive "who was anointed".

35:33.note: Word order rearranged; S adds "upon it".

36:1.note: S adds "and before Eleazar the priest" and "of the congregation"; adds Manasseh.

36:5.note: Word order of final clause rearranged.

36:11.note: Noah spelled Ya'a; final lenashim untranslated.
